title: The Latest Crier for Nov 27, 2026
items:
Winter Door Decorating Contest

Show off your holiday spirit and win fun prizes! Open to all students and residence halls. 
Nov. 30 - Dec. 7 (ends at noon) 

Sign up here: Winter Door Decorating Contest 

Roommates may enter together! 

Themes: Holiday Movie, Winter Sports, Winter Wonderland, Ugly Sweater, "Dutchmas" 

Need supplies? Stop by the SI Office during the contest week from 7-8 PM for decorating materials!

Interested in joining a sports analytics club here at Central?

If you love sports and love the statistics involved with them, consider joining a Central College sports analytics club ! If you're interested in something like this, please reach out to Dr. Goodman at goodmanr@central.edu letting him know you have an interest. He'll be setting up an information meeting sometime soon, so get in on the ground floor of this! We'll find cool projects to work on and also try to connect with Central's sports teams to support their success while building your resume/portfolio.

Worship, Student Testimonies, & Pizza :)

Pizza, worship, & student testimonies! What is better than that after a week away?! See you on 11/29 @ The Calm @ 8:30 PM :)
